sources.title: Viking: VK2735 maintenance-study topline results
sources.assessment: The complete current Viking sponsor announcement remains consistent with the bounded Watch summary: approximately 180 otherwise healthy adults with obesity entered a 21-week weekly subcutaneous induction and a 12-week randomized maintenance period. Monthly and every-other-week figures remain sponsor-reported topline observations, not peer-reviewed results, an approved dosing schedule, UK authorisation, NICE/NHS access, supply or clinical approval. The planned oral-maintenance part is still not treated as completed.
sources.uncertainty: Sponsor-reported topline results have not been independently peer reviewed here; future development, regulatory review and longer-term durability remain uncertain.

sources.title: UK provider: oral Wegovy private availability
reviewedSections: Where can I buy the Wegovy pill?
Can I get the Wegovy pill on the NHS?
Are Wegovy pills available in the UK right now?
sources.assessment: The current provider page still offers a private prescription route after an online consultation and doctor review, states that oral Wegovy is not currently available on the NHS, labels its own service in stock from £87.97 and displays a 5 August 2026 medical-review date. The Watch continues to use this only as a provider statement about its own private service; it is not proof of SHIFT stock, general UK supply, NHS access or clinical approval. Provider speculation about future NHS approval and comparative efficacy remains excluded.
sources.uncertainty: Provider availability and price are time-sensitive and can change without notice; individual eligibility and stock are not guaranteed.
